play: (async () => { const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const o = document.querySelector('.coach-offer [data-o=no]'); if (o) o.click(); document.querySelector('[data-go=start]').click(); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && !document.querySelector('#hand .tc'); i++) await w(100); await w(600); const s = window.__evo.store.game.state; document.querySelector('#hand [data-card="' + s.players[0].hand[0] + '"]').click(); await w(200); document.querySelector('.acts [data-act=food]').click(); })()
played: (() => { const g = window.__evo.store.game; return !!g && g.state.phase === 'play' && g.state.round === 1 && !g.state.over; })()
